gap_text: The three selected components have separate native receipts; a single composed SDK worker using both ai-memory and SocratiCode through restart and handoff is not established.
next_check: Configure one codex-native-sdk worker with the ai-memory and SocratiCode MCPs, run a bounded task, kill and restart it, then complete it via an ai-memory handoff. Record what is recovered.

preregistration.expectation: One codex-native-sdk worker configured with an isolated ai-memory MCP and a disposable-Qdrant SocratiCode MCP can run a bounded two-step task, be killed after step 1, and a fresh worker can recover progress from an ai-memory handoff and finish step 2. Recovered state is exactly what was written to ai-memory; in-process thread state is lost (ephemeral thread).
criteria: Run 1: worker searches SocratiCode for step-1 facts and writes a handoff/page to isolated ai-memory, then the process group is SIGKILLed.
Run 2: new worker process reads the handoff via ai-memory MCP, completes step 2 using SocratiCode, returns final JSON.
Record: which facts were recovered, whether any SocratiCode index had to be rebuilt, tool calls per run, usage per run, and whether the handoff content matched.
Detection: the kill is verified by process exit status/signal; the handoff is verified by reading the isolated store after the kill.
